parameters.content:
## 🚀 1. Registration & QR Pass Engine
**Path:** `POST /event-registration`
- **Flow:** Receives student registration ➔ Calculates next sequential `ParticipantID` & auto-generates `TeamID` ➔ Saves to Google Sheets ➔ Calls QR server API to generate dynamic QR ➔ Uploads QR image to Google Drive & sets public reader permission ➔ Updates row with Drive webViewLink ➔ Dispatches personalized confirmation email with QR pass link via Gmail.

## 📱 2. QR Attendance Check-In Pipeline
**Path:** `POST /attendance-checkin`
- **Flow:** Staff portal scanner reads attendee QR badge ➔ Queries Google Sheets by `ParticipantID` ➔ Verifies if status is 'Pending' ➔ If valid, updates status to `Present` with check-in timestamp ➔ Returns instant JSON status to Staff UI (or flags duplicate check-ins).

## 🎓 3. Dynamic Certificate Generation & Dispatch
**Path:** `POST /send-certificates` / Manual Execution
- **Flow:** Queries Google Sheets for all attendees marked `Present` ➔ Iterates through attendee batch ➔ Duplicates master Google Slides Certificate template ➔ Injects Participant Name, Event Name, and Date ➔ Converts & downloads as crisp PDF ➔ Emails PDF certificate to attendee along with Feedback Form link ➔ Updates Sheet with `Certificate Sent = yes`.

## 🤖 4. AI Feedback Intelligence & Executive Insights
**Path:** `POST /event-feedback`
- **Flow:** Collects post-event feedback into Feedback Sheet ➔ Aggregates all participant feedback & ratings ➔ Feeds full survey dataset to **Groq Llama 3.1 8B LLM** ➔ Generates an executive HTML report with Sentiment score, Key Highlights, Areas for Improvement & Strategic Action Items ➔ Dispatches beautiful HTML report email to organizer (`heemanshu20077@gmail.com`).
